[1st March, 1965]
An Ordinance to
provide for the remuneration and privileges of the Speaker of the National
Assembly
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Speaker's Remuneration
and Privileges Ordinance, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Salary, etc., of the Speaker

THE SPEAKER'S REMUNERATION AND PRIVILEGES ORDINANCE, 1965
THE SPEAKER'S
REMUNERATION AND PRIVILEGES ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. V OF 1965
[Approved
by the National Assembly on 8th July, 1965, see Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext.. p. 519.]
[1st March, 1965]
An Ordinance to
provide for the remuneration and privileges of the Speaker of the National
Assembly
2. Salary, etc., of the
Speaker.---(1) The Speaker of the National Assembly (hereinafter referred
to as the Speaker) shall be entitled to the same salary, allowances (except
sumptuary allowance) and other privileges as are admissible to a member of the
President's Council of Ministers.
(2) The Speaker shall be entitled
to a sumptuary allowance at the rate of one thousand rupees per mensem.

Repeal

3. Repeal.---The Speaker
and Deputy Speaker (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1955, in so far as it relates
to the Speaker is hereby repealed.

Validation

4. Validation.---The
salaries and allowances (including discretionary grant) already drawn and the
privileges already enjoyed by the Speaker from the 11th day of June, 1962, till
the commencement of this Ordinance shall be deemed to have been validly drawn
and enjoyed, as if this Ordinance were then in force.
